newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing share market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing share market report.

text.p: Dutch shares closed sharply lower, with the AEX index of 25 blue chip shares falling over four percent in a single day for the second time this week.
The AEX's fall of 4.40 percent to 894.42 brought its cumulative decline since a record close of 1010.97 just over a week ago to 11.5 percent.
However, even after taking that into account the AEX index has still risen some 38 percent so far this year.
Dealers said turnover had been heavy as private investors who had previously seemed willing to buy shares at any price took profits, amid worries the tide may be turning for equities.
The rout was most severe among the big blue chip stocks, with the AMX index of 25 second-tier or mid-cap stocks falling just less than two percent to 1435.26.
Dealers said it was difficult to unravel the extent to which Friday's August options expiry had magnified the fall.
Prices were lower from the opening bell and the decline acclerated in late trade as Wall Street opened lower.
Some dealers said the decline in share prices might now have run its course as investors who had wanted to take profits had probably done so by now.
"I think we'll probably see a stabilisation on Monday because this is already beginning to look like an overreaction," said one dealer.
